evidence_character: FACT — REPRODUCED OBITUARY / FAMILY RELATIONSHIP RECORD
confidence: HIGH FOR REPORTED FAMILY RELATIONSHIP; MEDIUM FOR MILE-HI CONTEXT
evidence_boundary: This independently documents a Scott Sandberg of Prescott Valley as a member of the Sandberg family associated with Sandberg’s Family Restaurant. It does not establish that this Scott Sandberg is the same person named as the 1984 Mile-Hi BMX contact, establish his ownership or employment at the restaurant, connect him to Scott’s Bike Shop, connect either business to Mile-Hi BMX, reverse 602-772-8050, or locate the track or Summer Camp footprint.
admission_basis: The reproduced obituary explicitly identifies Ray and Ruby Sandberg as Diane Sandberg-Laipple’s parents, describes the family’s 1976 move to Prescott Valley to open a family restaurant, names Sandberg’s Family Restaurant, and identifies Scott Sandberg of Prescott Valley as her brother.
